title: FantacalcioAcquisitionManifest
description: Provenance manifest for ONE raw-acquisition attempt of a Fantacalcio XLSX from the private endpoint to the private Drive (Batch 0D, design-only). One manifest per attempt (success/skipped/failed/rejected). NO real workflow/HTTP/Drive here. NEVER store secrets, credentials, real base URLs, tokens, or real Drive ids: source_url_template uses the ENV ref only; source_url_resolved_redacted keeps the base redacted; auth_secret_ref is symbolic. Real manifests live in the private Drive under Manifests/<season>/.

acquisition_id.description: Stable id for this attempt (e.g. uuid or season-matchday-timestamp). Used as Manifests/<season>/<acquisition_id>.json.

season_code.description: Numeric server code 10..21. 21 = 2026_27. Mapping versioned in docs/data/RAW_ACQUISITION_CONTRACT.md.

source_url_template.description: URL template with ENV placeholder ONLY. Never the real base URL/secret.

source_url_resolved_redacted.description: Resolved path with the base URL REDACTED. Never the real host. e.g. <FANTACALCIO_XLSX_SOURCE_BASE_URL>/api/v1/Excel/votes/16/38

auth_secret_ref.description: Symbolic ref to the auth secret (e.g. 'FANTACALCIO_XLSX_SOURCE_AUTH_SECRET_REF' or 'n8n_credential:fantacalcio_xlsx_endpoint'). NEVER the token/value.

original_filename.description: From Content-Disposition when present; null otherwise.

canonical_filename.description: Deterministic name from season+matchday (e.g. Voti_Fantacalcio_2021_22_G38.xlsx). Null on skip/failed with no payload.

drive_target_path.description: Conceptual Drive path of the stored payload (Raw/<season>/... or Rejected/<season>/...). Null when nothing stored. No real Drive ids.

raw_hash.description: sha256 of the raw bytes computed BEFORE any transform. Null when no valid payload acquired.

error_code.description: Set on failed (e.g. auth_error, server_error). Null otherwise.

skipped_reason.description: Set on skipped (e.g. file_not_available, already_acquired). Null otherwise.

rejected_reason.description: Set on rejected (e.g. non_excel_payload, hash_change_conflict). Null otherwise.

acquired_by.description: Symbolic actor (e.g. 'n8n:fantacalcio_raw_acquisition'). Not a real account/email.
